author: Zintenka
body:
Every time I log onto TS I get messages with these lines of words in chat. It's annoying. It's continuous. And when I try to talk about it in a civil and calm manner... everything I say just Pheeewp! Goes out the other ear.

Please do something, people like Zac, Merlin, Glitchy etc constantly do this every time I enter TS. I want to socialize and chat with people I haven't spoken to in months. I want to do it peacefully. This is a recurring problem and harrassment is - I believe - punishable. They've been doing this many times, I think a week tempban or a perma ban should be given out to these people.

Disgusting.


I tried to confront them today about the issue but Fraps doesn't record TS apparently. So I've lost the video evidence of our "civil" discussion. But There were racial slurs in the Nightclub chat and the same phrases from before pertaining to this same line of quoting above.

Here's chat.

They continously make the same annoying comment. I decided to threaten them that I'm recording (Fraps only records games apparently, otherwise I would've put up audio) get them to permanently stop the continuous bullshit.

But they continue.



Things escalate higher and MLGTino gets involved on the behalf of the aggressors. He doesn't try to stop the teasing and in fact joins them in pestering me. I thought that he and Merlin were cool guys. But this? What is this? What is happening to these people?



Another person gets involved. I don't want to show their identity as it might get them targeted by these harrassers. So I'm putting them as Anonymous.



MLGTino tries to derail the argument to somewhere else so that the issue will remain unsolved. I get distracted for a bit trying to educate him.



Continous. It is at this point that I'm wondering, "Who is this person?". So I ask, the person responds, "Anonymous" reveals their identity.



I'm shocked at the person's identity as MLGTino seemed like a cool person from my point of view. But the person's response is somewhat panicky and they start cursing. Leading me to believe that the person really IS MLGTino. An IP check wouldn't work as a person can have multiple computers and each computer has a unique IP to it.

Zac goads me on to enter the Nightclub chat room saying that he'll quote and unquote, "Destroy me". I enter to get more evidence on my "recording" (Why you no record other apps Fraps ;_;). He results to racial slurs "Nigger" and "How many niggers does it take to repair a microwave.". 

It is disgusting that we live in 2015 - the 21st Century - and we still have people that resort to such vulgar and archaic ways of insulting. This is stuff done 200 or so years ago. This is the stuff done in the 1950s. This is the stuff done by miserable and sad pathetic excuses for human beings.

I don't know whether this is legal or not in the Nightclub. But if it is, then this is unacceptable. Unless if it is for jokes, then racism - in a manner meant to insult - should be bannable. We the millenials should set an example for the younger generation to not repeat the same mistakes in the past. An environment this volatile is unfit. This is also part of the reason why I left in the first place.



By this time, I've left the Nightclub and I discuss with "Anonymous". I feel that if he were to get involved he would get targeted as well. I don't want anyone to have to suffer on my behalf.

That's selfish and fucked up.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
It first happened in chat #4. Then the racism happened in the Nightclub channel.

Even IF racism is allowed in Nightclub, I highly doubt that racism in a harmful manner instead of a joking and casual manner would be allowed.

Besides, they were harrassing me without swearing in the normal chats - still punishable.
